entry.title: Capital Planning Committee: the meeting of 10 November 2026 — recording, transcript and our minutes
entry.summary: Committee declined to weigh in on the track article, kept the senior center network project, and set meetings for Nov 19 and Nov 30. The recording is on the town’s channel (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pa1BCL9YAJk), its captions are searchable, and our minutes are written from them; the video at its timestamp is the record.
